rule: L1 is positive if, on S8, SPECIES gives |rho(slope, a)| >= 0.40 with a LOCO-stable sign, |partial rho | n_metals| >= 0.40, and the chemotype-blocked CI excludes zero.  It is closed if |rho| < 0.25 on S8 with a CI containing zero.  Between 0.25 and 0.40 it is 'not closed, not positive' and is said so.
